title: WhatsApp message received and AI responds
description: Lead sends text message → webhook receives → tenant resolved → lead created/found → conversation tracked → AI generates response → message sent back via Kapso

title: Stripe checkout completes successfully
description: User clicks upgrade → create-checkout-session → Stripe hosted page → payment succeeds → webhook fires → subscription created → profile updated → email sent

title: Kapso connection created via QR Code
description: Admin opens Conexoes → clicks API Nao Oficial → kapso-manager creates instance → QR code displayed → user scans → connection.update webhook fires → status=ativa

title: OpenAI timeout during WhatsApp response
description: Lead sends message → AI processing starts → OpenAI takes >30s → AbortController fires → fallback message sent → agent_executions marked failed

title: Stripe webhook signature verification fails
description: Stripe sends webhook → signature header present but doesn't match secret → constructEventAsync throws → returns 400 → Stripe retries

title: Kapso API unreachable during message send
description: AI generates response → sendViaKapso fails → retry 1 (2s backoff) fails → retry 2 (4s backoff) fails → message lost, lead never gets response

title: Tenant not resolved for incoming WhatsApp
description: Message arrives → 5-level tenant resolution all fail → function returns early → message silently dropped, no error to sender

title: Duplicate webhook delivery (Kapso + cold start)
description: Kapso retries webhook → in-memory dedup cache is empty (cold start) → DB upsert catches duplicate BUT race window exists between two simultaneous cold starts

title: Lead sends message with zero-length text
description: WhatsApp delivers empty text message or media-only with no caption → text="" → AI receives empty context → unpredictable response

title: Phone number with country code variations
description: Lead has +55 vs 55 vs 5511 vs 011 → telefone matching in DB may fail → creates duplicate lead for same person

title: Subscription webhook arrives before checkout callback
description: Stripe fires customer.subscription.created → profile not yet updated with stripe_customer_id → tenant resolution fails in webhook handler

title: Two messages from same lead in <1 second
description: Lead sends 2 rapid messages → both hit webhook simultaneously → both try to create conversation → race on INSERT → one fails or creates duplicate

title: Double-click on Stripe checkout button
description: User clicks upgrade twice rapidly → two checkout sessions created → user completes one → second session orphaned → potential double charge if both complete

title: Connection.update and message arrive simultaneously
description: Kapso sends connection.update (state=open) and first message at same time → message arrives before config updated → tenant resolution fails

title: Kapso API returns 429 Rate Limit
description: kapso-manager or sendViaKapso gets 429 → no backoff for API management calls (only message sending has retry) → operation fails silently

title: Stripe subscription.deleted fires but email service is down
description: Subscription cancelled → manageSubscriptionStatusChange runs → sendEmail fails silently (try/catch) → user never notified of cancellation

title: Kapso webhook secret header uses wrong header name
description: Kapso sends x-kapso-signature but code checks x-webhook-secret first → OR operator handles it but if Kapso changes header convention, auth breaks

title: WhatsApp message with special characters in name
description: Contact name contains emoji, RTL characters, or SQL-like patterns → stored in lead.nome → displayed in UI without sanitization issues?

title: Media URL expired before media-processor downloads
description: Lead sends image → webhook stores mediaUrl → media-processor called seconds later → Kapso media URL expired → download fails → extractedText empty

title: Stripe price in different currency than BRL
description: Stripe webhook delivers amount in cents (USD) → formatPrice assumes BRL → email shows wrong amount to user

title: Attacker floods whatsapp-webhook with fake payloads
description: Attacker sends thousands of POST requests with valid-looking Kapso payloads → rate limit is 120/60s per IP → still allows 120 OpenAI calls per minute per IP

title: Price manipulation via create-checkout-session
description: User modifies priceId in request body to a cheaper price → create-checkout-session passes it to Stripe without validating against allowed prices

title: Tenant ID spoofing in WhatsApp webhook
description: Attacker crafts Kapso payload with instanceName=jurify_OTHERTENANT → tenant resolution via prefix matches wrong tenant → messages go to wrong law firm

title: 100+ unread messages queue for single conversation
description: Lead sends many messages while office is closed → unread_count increments 100+ → UI loads all messages at once → performance degradation

title: Thousands of concurrent WhatsApp connections per tenant
description: Enterprise tenant creates many Kapso instances → each generates webhooks → rate limit shared across all → legitimate messages throttled

title: Subscription expires at midnight but user is mid-session
description: Stripe fires subscription.deleted at 00:00 → webhook updates profile → user currently using app → next API call sees expired subscription → abrupt feature lockout

title: Kapso QR code expires before user scans
description: Admin triggers QR code → walks away → returns 5 min later → QR expired → no feedback in UI → user waits indefinitely thinking it's loading

title: WhatsApp message timestamp vs server time mismatch
description: Message sent at 23:59 local time → arrives at server 00:01 UTC next day → date-based queries miss messages near midnight boundaries

title: Viewer role user accesses kapso-manager
description: Viewer has JWT → calls kapso-manager directly via fetch → role check is ["admin","manager"] → returns 403 → BUT what if role check query fails? Falls through?

title: Deactivated user still has valid JWT
description: Admin deactivates user via UsuariosManager → user's existing JWT still valid until expiry → can still access data for token lifetime

title: Server crash mid-Stripe webhook processing
description: Webhook received → idempotency row inserted → crash before subscription updated → Stripe retries → idempotency check says "already processed" → subscription never updated

title: Kapso connection lost and auto-reconnect fails
description: Connection drops → connection.update state="close" → status set to inativa → no auto-reconnect mechanism → messages lost until admin manually reconnects

title: Lead status downgrade attempt via auto-qualification
description: Lead is in "proposta" status → new message arrives → analyzeQualification suggests "qualificado" → should NOT downgrade → verify never-downgrade rule works

title: Subscription goes active→past_due→active rapidly
description: Payment fails → past_due → user updates card → new payment succeeds → active → but webhook ordering not guaranteed → past_due webhook arrives AFTER active

title: Stripe checkout.session.completed + subscription.created arrive simultaneously
description: Both webhooks fire at same moment → both try to upsert subscriptions → race condition on tenant_id + stripe_subscription_id

title: Kapso returns HTML error page instead of JSON
description: Kapso is in maintenance → returns 503 with HTML body → kapsoFetch tries .json() → throws → error message contains full HTML page in logs

title: WhatsApp message arrives during Edge Function cold start
description: First message after idle → function cold starts (2-3s) → Kapso/Meta has short webhook timeout → times out → retries → dedup catches second attempt but response delayed

title: Coordinated webhook flood from multiple IPs
description: Distributed attack sends fake webhooks from 100+ IPs → rate limit per IP allows 120*100=12000 req/min → OpenAI API costs explode

title: Lead sends only sticker or location
description: WhatsApp sticker message → no text content → media-processor can't process sticker → extractedText="" → AI responds to empty context

title: Admin disconnects while message is being processed
description: Admin clicks disconnect → kapso-manager sends logout → simultaneously webhook processes message → tries to send response → Kapso API rejects (disconnected)

title: OpenAI rate limit hit during peak hours
description: Multiple tenants sending messages → all hit OpenAI concurrently → 429 rate limit → no retry for OpenAI calls → all get fallback message → office appears unresponsive

title: JWT expires mid-checkout flow
description: User starts checkout → JWT expires while on Stripe page → returns to success URL → app sees expired session → redirects to login → loses checkout context

title: Webhook event with missing nested fields
description: Kapso sends payload where data.key exists but data.message is undefined → code accesses data.message.text → TypeError → 500 response

title: Database connection pool exhausted during webhook burst
description: Black Friday-like traffic → many webhooks simultaneously → Supabase connection pool full → all DB operations fail → messages lost, no recovery

title: Forged instanceName to access other tenant data
description: Attacker creates instance named jurify_VICTIM_TENANT → webhook resolves to victim's tenant_id → attacker's messages appear in victim's conversation list

title: Invoice amount is zero (free trial end with no charge)
description: Stripe fires invoice.payment_succeeded with amount=0 → email template shows "R$0,00" → confusing to user

title: Multiple admin users manage Kapso connection simultaneously
description: Admin A creates connection → Admin B also clicks create → two instances created → only one gets webhooks → inconsistent state

title: Message arrives exactly at rate limit boundary
description: Request 120 arrives at window boundary → rate limit check → window expires mid-check → should allow or deny?

title: Kapso instance name collision across tenants
description: Two tenants both try jurify_lawfirm → Kapso API allows only one → second fails → unclear error message to admin

title: Edge Function hits memory limit processing large audio file
description: Lead sends 10-minute audio → media-processor downloads base64 (~20MB) → Deno memory limit hit → function crashes → no response sent

title: Lead changes WhatsApp number
description: Lead contacts from new phone → system creates new lead → duplicate client data → no merge mechanism

title: Kapso API changes payload format without notice
description: Kapso updates their API → field names change → isKapsoPayload() still matches → normalization fails silently → empty/wrong data stored

title: Replay attack on WhatsApp webhook
description: Attacker captures valid webhook payload → replays it hours later → dedup window (5 min in-memory) expired → DB check may pass if webhook_events cleaned up → message processed again

title: Trial period ends exactly when user is sending first message
description: Trial expires → subscription.deleted fires → profile updated to free tier → message hits AI → AI limit check (if exists) blocks → user's first experience is failure

title: Unicode right-to-left override in lead name
description: Lead sends name with RTL override character → displayed incorrectly in UI tables → potential UI layout breaking
